title: Draft Calibration for Speculative Decoding: Accelerating LLM Serving by Matching Draft and Target Distributions
abstract: arXiv:2611.33111v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by employing a lightweight draft model to propose draft tokens and allowing the target model to verify the new tokens in parallel to improve inference-time compute utilization. The speedup relies on the acceptance probability of draft tokens in target verification, which is directly related to the gap $\|p-q\|_1$ between the target distribution $p$ and the draft distribution $q$. In this paper, we study draft calibration of speculative decoding to improve the speedup of speculative decoding, where we employ post-hoc methods to calibrate the draft distribution to mitigate the distribution gap. We observe that though current community open-source draft models may learn the top candidate token correctly, they are generally underconfident compared to the target model, suggesting a consistent distribution mismatch. translated_title: 面向推测解码的草稿校准：通过匹配草稿分布与目标分布加速大语言模型服务
translated_abstract: 推测解码通过采用轻量级草稿模型提出草稿 token，并允许目标模型并行验证新 token，从而提高推理阶段的计算利用率，加速大语言模型（LLM）推理。其加速效果取决于草稿 token 在目标模型验证中的接受概率，而该概率与目标分布 $p$ 和草稿分布 $q$ 之间的差距 $\|p-q\|_1$ 直接相关。本文研究推测解码中的草稿校准方法，以提升推测解码的加速效果：我们采用事后校准方法对草稿分布进行校准，从而缓解分布差距。我们观察到，尽管当前社区开源的草稿模型可能正确学习到最优候选 token，但与目标模型相比它们普遍存在置信度不足的问题，这表明存在系统性的分布失配。为减轻这种失配对接受率的影响……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出推测解码中的草稿校准方法，通过事后校准解决开源草稿模型相对目标模型普遍置信度不足的分布失配问题，缩小草稿分布与目标分布之间的差距，从而提高草稿 token 接受率并加速大语言模型推理服务。
